title: Improvement and copy-edit as an agent
description:
Definition for `improve`: copy editing against the site's policies on a draft (woken by the checklist step), and improvement passes on published Stories (woken by a person's request or a redirect, never by a schedule that walks the archive). Editorial rewriting uses the `editorial` tier; rule checks are free. Every change is a new version with a reason. Articles are never locked: a new event may be folded into any article where it fits, as an Assignment.

**Acceptance criteria**
- A draft's copy-edit step runs when ready.
- A published Story is improved only on a request or a relevant new event.
- Every change is a new version a person can revert.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- improve-agent.feature: the copy-edit step runs once per version; an improvement request produces a new version; nothing walks the archive on a timer; revert restores the earlier version.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** None.

**Part of:** Every other responsibility as an agent. Slice code M6 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.
